Target Beneficiaries 
Current System Limitations
Proposed AI Solution
Government Alignment 
Students from regional language backgrounds.
Learners with dyslexia, ADHD, visual/hearing impairments.
Teachers who lack tools to create accessible learning content.
Most e-learning platforms provide static English-centric content
with limited accessibility and personalization, making learning
difficult for diverse learners.
EduMorph AI converts educational documents into multilingual
videos, audio lessons, simplified notes, and adaptive quizzes while
supporting accessibility modes for different learning needs.

PROPOSED SOLUTION
Solution Overview
We are building an AI-powered Inclusive Learning
Platform that helps students learn in a more personalized,
accessible, and engaging way. Students simply choose
their learning profile, preferred language, and education
level. Our fine-tuned AI model understands the learning
content and generates a customized teaching script
tailored to each learner's needs. The platform then
converts the script into narrated educational slides with
adaptive 
explanations, 
making 
learning 
easier 
to
understand and more interactive. It provides descriptive
audio support for visually impaired learners and subtitle-
friendly visual content for hearing-impaired learners. By
combining AI personalization with accessibility, our
solution ensures that every student receives an effective,
inclusive, and engaging learning experience.
Key Highlights
AI-Powered PDF Content Understanding
Personalized Educational Video Generation
Accessibility Support for Visually & Hearing Impaired Students
Multi-Language Learning Support
Unique Value Proposition 
Our fine-tuned AI creates personalized learning experiences by adapting
content according to the student's profile, language, and accessibility
needs instead of providing the same content to everyone.
